messages:
maya: Heads-up — nightly eval showed a sharp quality regression on quant-ggml-2.7b for the 'customer-support' prompt set, 12/12 failing examples vs baseline. attaching logs.

 eval-bot: nightly-eval | model=quant-ggml-2.7b | suite=regression-smoke | fails=12/200 | delta=-7.3 ppl | run=1850001200

 sam: ugh. did we change caching or batching in the last deploy? :thinking_face:

 maya: yes — rolled narrow-batching optimization yesterday (r2345). it merged KV slots across concurrent short requests to reduce memory. suspected interactions with prefix cache keys.

 toni: can you paste the cache key format that's used?

 maya: sure — simplified:
```
# cache key generation (py)
key = f"{tenant_id}:{model_name}:{prefix_hash & 0xffffffff}:{seq_len_bucket}"
# prefix_hash = xxh64(prefix)  # then truncated to 32 bits for storage
```

 maya: truncating xxh64 to 32 bits + slot merging = plausible aliasing between different prefixes/tenants.

 li: quick test: I re-ran the nightly eval with cache disabled: `./run_eval.sh --model quant-ggml-2.7b --cache=off`
 li: result: fails dropped to 1/200, metrics back to baseline.

 sam: that's a smoking gun. caching off -> no regressions.

 maya: also repro locally by sending two prompts A and B concurrently with short seqs and watching merged KV slot contain tokens from the other request.

 li: logs (snip):
```
[slot-alloc] slot=42 owner=tenant:alpha prefix=0x7a3d
[slot-merge] slot=42 owner=tenant:beta prefix=0x1b8f -> merged
[kv-lookup] key=tenant:beta:0x7a3d -> returned tokens for tenant:alpha
```

 toni: likely causes: (1) prefix_hash truncation collision, (2) slot key not salted by tenant, or (3) batching merge forgot to namespace per-tenant.

 dan: (from eng-runtime) we did change the merge path to use 32-bit keys to reduce mem footprint — that lines up.

 sam: short-term mitigation: disable slot sharing for now (roll back r2345) and re-run full nightly. mid-term: fix key to include full 64-bit hash or salt with tenant_id and add unit tests.

 maya: agreed. open bug and assign owners. I'll add a reproducer script.

 sam: action items:
- sam -> open bug ENG-ML-1234 with logs + reproducer
- dan -> temporary revert of slot-sharing in staging (r2345 revert)
- li -> run full nightly with revert and post results
- toni -> implement salted 64-bit cache keys + test

 maya: PR for reproducer: `github.com/redwood-inference/serving/compare/...` (WIP)

 eval-bot: nightly-eval queued under run=1850001800 after revert.

 li: posted run results: after revert fails 2/200, investigating remaining two cases.

 maya: thanks all — tracking in ENG-ML-1234. :thumbsup:
